Dashiell Hammett, The Maltese Falcon.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/dashiell-hammett/the-maltese-falcon

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Dashiell Hammett, the author, died 1961.

First publication of the text used: 1929 in the serial form (Black Mask magazine, United States, September 1929 to January 1930), then 1930 as a book (SE colophon: 'was published in 1930 by Dashiell Hammett'). Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Maltese_Falcon_(novel)) gives country United States and the serial dates.

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1929 (serial) and 1930 (book), before 1931, so the United States rule settles the origin too. Wikipedia states that the serialized version entered the United States public domain on 1 January 2025.
- Country of origin (United States): the same as the United States paragraph above, because the text was first published in the United States before 1931.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon: 1930 edition by Dashiell Hammett
- Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Maltese_Falcon_(novel) (country United States; Black Mask serial September 1929 to January 1930; Knopf 1930)
